item.text:
- Work in `D:\openvault`; filesystem is read-only and approvals are unavailable.
- For project tasks, first consult OpenVault MCP: project briefing, activity, relevant team skills, and active work.
- Before editing, announce intended paths in OpenVault and check for overlaps/suggestions.
- Read the installed Next.js documentation before writing Next.js code, since this project uses a breaking-change version.
- Preserve unrelated changes; use `apply_patch` for edits; avoid destructive commands.
- Verify code changes with `npm run check` where feasible.
- Record useful decisions, findings, and handoffs back into OpenVault before finishing.
- Do not delegate to sub-agents unless explicitly requested or required by applicable instructions.
- Use relevant listed skills when their trigger conditions apply; announce skill use in commentary.
- Keep the user updated during tool-based work and provide a self-contained final response.
